build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where two dynamic sticks must hit each other using define_task_template decorator
create_dynamic_bars: create two vertical dynamic bars in the PHYRE scene using C.add with set_angle and set_left methods
add_static_bar: add a horizontal static bar to the PHYRE scene to prevent balls from dropping
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require two bodies to be TOUCHING using C.update_task with SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to TWO_BALLS solution tier using C.set_meta
